title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Researchers surveying a perennial flower strip dividing a cereal (left) and sugar beet (right) field in Lower Saxony, Germany. Such field margins reliably increase arthropod activity at the edge, but new findings suggest their benefits for pest control is limited and highly dependent on the species involved. Full details are available in the article by Ohlendorf et al, https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70504.
